prompt: Create a full-length instrumental fantasy game soundtrack song for Stonestep: a small stone town, pale quarry steps, green meadow and watchful moor. A sturdy, welcoming hill-country melody with fiddle and hand drum. Acoustic strings, soft flute, gentle hand percussion, memorable melodic theme, natural dynamics and a satisfying ending. No vocals, singing, speech, chanting, or spoken words. This is song 1 of two for this land; make it distinct and complete.
